description: Paid endpoint ($0.02): pre-built pack of the last ~7 days of twice-daily crypto digest briefs (primary writer plus standby backup for missed slots), full markdown bodies with sha256, for backtests. Different from get_history (date range, per day). Missing/stale pack returns an error and no charge. Returns x402 requirements + URL. Free sample: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/briefs-history
name: get_briefs_history
title: 7-day brief pack (paid, x402) — $0.02
